AL.name: Alabama
AL.notes: Board of Trustees policy requires disclosure to the school within 10 days of agreement. No statutory aggregate cap.

AZ.name: Arizona
AZ.notes: Athlete must disclose to school within 10 days. Minor requires parental consent.

AR.name: Arkansas
AR.notes: Disclosure within 14 days of deal execution. No aggregate cap.

CA.name: California
CA.notes: Ed Code 62300-62304 framework. No specific statutory disclosure window; school policy can set a tighter window. Minor protections require parental consent.

CO.name: Colorado
CO.notes: Disclosure to school within 14 days. No aggregate cap.

FL.name: Florida
FL.notes: Disclosure to school within 60 days (lenient). FHSAA has additional high school minor rules.

GA.name: Georgia
GA.notes: Disclosure to school within 10 days. No aggregate cap.

IL.name: Illinois
IL.notes: Disclosure within 14 days. IHSA policy governs high school minor athletes.

IN.name: Indiana
IN.notes: Disclosure within 14 days. IHSAA rules govern high school athletes.

IA.notes: Disclosure within 10 days. No aggregate cap.

KY.notes: Disclosure within 10 days. No aggregate cap.

ME.name: Maine
ME.notes: Disclosure within 14 days. Minor protections via Maine principals' association.

MD.name: Maryland
MD.notes: Disclosure within 14 days to school. No aggregate cap.

MA.name: Massachusetts
MA.notes: No statutory disclosure window; school policy governs. MIAA rules govern high school athletes.

MI.name: Michigan
MI.notes: Disclosure within 10 days to school. MHSAA rules govern high school athletes.

MN.name: Minnesota

caps.description: Schools may set aggregate NIL caps for their athletes; no statutory cap on individual athletes
